question:
As of 2026-10-09, can the CURRENT IMD Ethereum standard-token/v4-hook launch preserve ALL these IMPEPE requirements? Answer YES only with verified support for all; otherwise NO or UNVERIFIED, identifying blockers and minimal adaptations. Cite official docs, actual factory code/addresses and deployment precedents. Generic free-check fallback is not evidence. This is capability research, not an audit or deployment request.

1. IMPEPE/IMPEPE plain ERC20, 1B supply, 88% liquidity/10% swarm/2% payer, IMD pair, standard pool fee 12500 (1% payer +0.25% network), tick spacing 60.
2. Supplied hook source, SIX constructor args: ($poolManager,$token,$factory,0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7,0x42a02182432b7de815085efdbed8a0173f813f28,int24(60)). Literal router already deployed; do not replace support contracts.
3. CREATE2 permission bits 0x2acc: beforeInitialize/beforeAddLiquidity/beforeRemoveLiquidity/beforeSwap/afterSwap/beforeSwapReturnDelta/afterSwapReturnDelta. Factory-only initialization; reject negative liquidity removal, allow additions and zero-delta LP fee collection.
4. Custom 3% fee from gross IMD buy input/sell output; KEEP IMD, no ETH conversion. Deferred ERC-6909 claims, flushFees settlement, router.routeAmount. Existing router funds creation until NFT #1000, then equal pull rewards. Exact-input only, reject partial fills.
5. Override default opening FDV 2500 IMD to 1000 IMD with correct token-order sqrtPriceX96.

Precedent: https://explorer.imd.fun/jobs/babb0da2-bd96-4fe7-b753-945acdf5872e . Source is locally prepared, not attached: do not claim source review. If compatible, give accepted manifest schema and exact source-submission method. Distinguish service capability evidence from an Oracle opinion; a signed answer is not factory execution proof.

sources: oracle.json brief: hook source is 'locally prepared, not attached', review forbidden; precedent link is a job record, not factory proof; generic free-check fallback disallowed as evidence -> no verifiable source/bytecode exists in this seat to confirm all 5 impepe requirements against 0x2acc bits, 6 ctor args, router/support addrs, 3% fee/erc-6909/nft#1000/fdv logic.

definitions.capability_standard: YES requires evidence of support for every listed requirement in the requested current launch path; an unrelated successful launch is evidence of partial capability only.
definitions.unknown_configuration: UNVERIFIED when public evidence does not establish that a required configuration is accepted or executed by the current factory.
